title: Took the traceability platform to 14 businesses
summary: I conceived the AI-assisted traceability platform and guided its team from a first pilot to production in 14 businesses.
what_would_have_happened: Trace work would stay manual and gaps would be found late, when they are expensive.
the_call: Grow business by business, one validated release at a time.
what_i_did: Set the design, secured funding and guided the team from a first pilot to production.
what_changed: 14 businesses in production; a quality program manager called my vision inspiring.

quotes.text: Datta's communication and collaboration style is very positive and always looking for opportunities. It is simply lovely to collaborate with him. His vision is inspiring.
